title: Group M fire areas.
officialText:
An automatic sprinkler system shall be provided throughout any Group M occupancy fire
area where any one of the following conditions exists:
1. The fire area exceeds 7,500 square feet (697 m2).
2. The fire area of any size contains an unenclosed stair or escalator connecting two or more floors.
